datasets.source: NASA Goddard Cosmic Ice Laboratory, C3 hydrocarbon optical constants (2021 publication)

measurement.mode: Imaginary refractive index derived by publisher from normal-incidence transmission FTIR measurements and optical-constants analysis
measurement.instrument: FTIR; paper identifies Thermo iS50 for phase checks; selected workbook does not separately name the optical-constants acquisition instrument
measurement.conditionsZh: 8 K 非晶固体；气相沉积在预冷 CsI 或 KBr 基底，正入射透射 FTIR 后由作者计算光学常数。不是室温液体谱。
measurement.substrate: CsI or KBr; selected workbook block does not specify which substrate
measurement.thicknessNote: Paper reports multiple ice thicknesses ~0.25–2 µm for intensity measurements. No unique thickness assigned to this optical-constants workbook block.
measurement.resolutionNote: ~0.0603 cm^-1 source grid spacing is not the 0.5 cm^-1 instrumental resolution.
measurement.publisherProcessing: Optical constants derived by publisher from measured transmission spectra using updated iterative optical-constants analysis with substrate effects and refractive-index measurements. Source contains negative baseline/numerical-processing values, which are retained and do not represent physical negative absorption.
measurement.knownContaminants: Paper reports small features from ~0.1% CO2 at 2338 cm^-1 and ~1% allene at 1948 cm^-1 in amorphous propyne; no peaks are removed here.
